content:
maya: Drafting internal RN for the micro-release touching runtime + router. Dropping a short draft below — need pin owners, canary window, and rollback thresholds.

maya: ```Release Notes (internal draft)
- Runtime v2.14.0: improved KV-cache eviction heuristics to reduce p99 token latency (~8% improvement)
- Router: add smart fallback route to model-prod-v1-qs when quantization path fails
- Ops plan: canary traffic for 30m in us-west-2, then gradual ramp to 100% over 1h if stable
- Rollback: automatic fallback to model-prod-v1 + disable batching on rollback
- Version pins: runtime=v2.14.0, model-tag=rpi-2026-03, router-config=canary-2026-03-a
- Known issue: short token-cost bump expected during cache warmup (~5-10m)
```

leo: Quick nit — please include the deploybot cue string we use so deploys show up in channel (e.g. `deploybot: schedule canary at 22:00 UTC`).

maya: Good call. Added deploybot cue and commit hash: `commit: 9f8b2e7`

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z (canary window 30m). ETA for full rollout: +1h if all checks pass.

ops-liu: I'll own the pinning for us-west-2 and will apply runtime=v2.14.0 at cut. Oncall for canary monitoring: erica. @maya add rollback thresholds (p99 / error rate) so ops has a turf.

erica: Acknowledged. Suggested automated rollback triggers:
- error-rate >= 5% sustained for 5m OR
- p99 latency increase > 40% vs baseline for 10m
I'll also watch tail latency and model errors.

sam: Is 30m still the ask? Traffic drops at that window so we may not catch some edge cases. Can we extend to 45m?

maya: We can keep 30m for a fast path and add a post-rollout 1h passive monitor with alerting. If anyone strongly prefers 45m, speak now.

leo: 30m + 1h passive sounds fine to me. Keep the deploybot staging cue visible in RN so comms team can copy it for the internal blast.

maya: Finalizing: canary=30m (us-west-2), passive monitor=1h post-rollout, rollback triggers as @erica suggested, pin owners = ops-liu (pin), maya (RN copy), erica (monitor). Deploybot scheduled and will post updates.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-15T22:00:00Z. Posting healthchecks to #eng-releases every 5m.

erica: Monitoring — p99 stable, errors nominal. Will call immediate rollback if triggers hit.

maya: Thanks team. I'll push internal announce copy to the comms doc and tag the release note owner. :thumbsup:
